result.title: Can the Parts Fool the Test? Counterfactual Pairing Cycles for Relational OOD
result.summary: Relational out-of-distribution errors are easy to describe and hard to evaluate cleanly. An image may be natural, a caption may be fluent, and all mentioned objects may be common, yet the caption may describe the wrong relation in the image. Many evaluations intended to test this behavior can be solved without checking the pairing at all, because negatives differ in caption style, template, length, object frequency, or image statistics. We propose counterfactual pairing cycles, a blocked evaluation primitive that reuses the same two images and the same two captions on both sides of the comparison, changing only which image is paired with which caption. This makes image-only, text-only, and additive component shortcuts cancel exactly in finite samples. The same contrast also gives a training loss for relational outlier exposure and a diagnostic for bilinear vision-language scores. Across synthetic controls, GQA, and COCO, cycles separate coarse image-caption matching from directional role-binding failures, while also identifying geometric size relations that remain strongly visible in global features. In a shortcut-contaminated COCO outlier-exposure stress test, a model selected by a near-perfect shortcut validation AUROC retains substantial relational signal but remains below cycle training on exact cycles; cycle training improves CycleAcc from 0.882 to 0.927. The main lesson is simple: to test whether a model understands a pairing, the benchmark should keep the parts fixed, change the pairing, and ask only about coupling. The official implementation is available online.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出「反事实配对循环」这一评估原语：对同一对图像与同一对描述做交叉配对，只改变图像与描述的对应关系，从而让纯图像、纯文本及加性捷径在有限样本下精确抵消；并在合成控制、GQA 与 COCO 上区分粗粒度匹配与方向性角色绑定失败，同时给出关系型 outlier exposure 训练损失与双线性 VL 评分诊断。
AI.relevance_reason: 该设计为核查 VLM 内部状态是否保留实体关系与几何（如尺寸）信息提供可迁移的度量工具，CycleAcc 与反事实对比可能用于评价关系耦合及训练中的关系贡献分配，具体效果有待核查。
